verdict.rationale: Kong is an API gateway and management platform, so scheduled API monitoring is a fair question for it, but the evidence pack documents no scheduled collection runs or monitors that alert when an API breaks. Gateway health checking of upstreams and Konnect status monitoring of control and data planes are adjacent features. They do not deliver scheduled collection-run monitors with alerting.

support.subject: As a developer, I can schedule collection runs as monitors that alert me when an API breaks
